entries.title: Permission-check security fixes for Bash and PowerShell
entries.paragraph: 2.1.214 patches several permission-check bypasses for Bash and PowerShell, hardens handling of very long commands and unsafe help/man invocations, adds a periodic heartbeat for long-running tool calls, and improves OpenTelemetry logging.
entries.whyItMatters: If you run Claude Code or the Agent SDK in any automated or shared context, these are permission-bypass fixes — upgrade to 2.1.214 or newer promptly.

entries.title: /fork moves to background, /subtask replaces in-session subagents, new session limits
entries.paragraph: /fork now copies a conversation into a background session, and the old in-session subagent is replaced by /subtask. Each session is now capped at 200 web searches and 200 subagent spawns.
entries.whyItMatters: Scripts or docs that referenced the old in-session subagent flow need updating, and long autonomous runs can now hit the 200-spawn / 200-search ceilings.

entries.title: Auto mode on by default on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry
entries.paragraph: Auto mode is now enabled by default on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry with no opt-in required. The release also fixes prompt-caching regressions on custom base URLs and improves streaming.
entries.whyItMatters: Unattended runs against those cloud backends now get auto mode's broader autonomy unless you explicitly set a stricter permission mode.

entries.title: Auto-allow git push to a configured push remote
entries.paragraph: Claude Code can now auto-allow git push to a remote you've configured as the push target, adds directory suggestions to /cd, and fixes MCP server timeout handling and expired-login error messages.
entries.whyItMatters: If a scheduled job keeps failing to push, configuring the push remote lets the agent push without a per-call prompt — directly relevant to unattended routines.

entries.title: permissionMode now rejects unrecognized values
entries.paragraph: The SDK now rejects unrecognized permissionMode values instead of silently ignoring them, and adds scheduled-trigger markers plus plugin version tracking.
entries.whyItMatters: A typo'd or stale permission-mode string in your config that used to be ignored will now throw at startup.

entries.title: Assistant messages get a timestamp; errors include CLI stderr
entries.paragraph: Assistant messages now carry an SDKAssistantMessage.timestamp, and error reporting now includes the CLI's stderr output.
entries.whyItMatters: You can timestamp assistant turns for latency metrics and get far more actionable output when a run fails.

entries.title: timedOutAfterMs on auto-backgrounded Bash output
entries.paragraph: BashToolOutput now includes timedOutAfterMs, set when a command is automatically backgrounded after running too long.
entries.whyItMatters: Your tooling can detect and react to commands that got auto-backgrounded instead of treating them as completed.

entries.title: parent_agent_id for multi-level agent trees
entries.paragraph: Streamed messages now include parent_agent_id, letting you reconstruct multi-level agent trees, alongside a fix for a crash in flag settings.
entries.whyItMatters: If you orchestrate nested subagents, you can now attribute each message to its spawning agent for tracing and cost accounting.

entries.title: MCP interactive auth is GA + new "writes" approval mode
entries.paragraph: MCP tools can now request interactive authentication without an experimental opt-in, and a new writes app-approval mode allows declared read-only actions while still prompting before writes. Usage-limit reset credits now show their type and expiration.
entries.whyItMatters: MCP OAuth flows no longer need an experimental flag, and the writes mode gives a safer default for semi-autonomous runs.

entries.title: GPT-5.6 model metadata + 272k context correction
entries.paragraph: Refreshed the bundled instructions for the GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models and corrected their context window to 272,000 tokens.
entries.whyItMatters: If you target GPT-5.6 through Codex, the corrected 272k context window changes how much you can safely pack into a single request.

entries.title: Service-account API key endpoint
entries.paragraph: Adds a service-account API-key endpoint for programmatic key management and fixes header normalization issues.
entries.whyItMatters: You can now create and rotate service-account keys directly through the SDK instead of the dashboard.

entries.title: Async event iterators + streaming file uploads
entries.paragraph: Introduces async event iterators, streaming file uploads, and improved stream handling for the Assistants API.
entries.whyItMatters: Streaming uploads let you send large files without buffering them fully in memory, cutting peak memory on upload-heavy services.

entries.title: GPT-5.6 model support
entries.paragraph: Adds support for the GPT-5.6 model family and fixes array-delta placement in the Assistants API streaming responses.
entries.whyItMatters: GPT-5.6 is now reachable straight from the Node SDK — no manual model-string plumbing needed.

suggestions.title: Upgrade Claude Code to 2.1.214+ before your next unattended run
suggestions.paragraph: 2.1.214 patches multiple permission-check bypasses. Any host running Claude Code non-interactively (CI, cron, shared boxes) should pin to >=2.1.214 and re-verify that allow/deny rules still behave as intended.
suggestions.whyItMatters: Permission bypasses are exactly the class of bug you don't want live in an automated agent that has shell access.

suggestions.title: Pin the permission mode for any cloud-backend agent run
suggestions.paragraph: Auto mode is now on by default on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry. If your service runs agents against those backends, set the permission mode explicitly rather than relying on the default, so a version bump can't silently widen autonomy.
suggestions.whyItMatters: A default that flips under you is a change in how much autonomy you grant — keep it in version control, not implicit.

example.code:
# be explicit instead of inheriting the new default
claude --permission-mode manual ...

suggestions.tiesTo: claude-code · 2.1.207 · Jul 11 — auto mode default on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry

suggestions.title: Validate permissionMode config strings against the known set
suggestions.paragraph: v0.3.214 rejects unknown permissionMode values instead of ignoring them. If you build that string from user or file config, validate it against the known set at your own boundary so you fail with a clear message rather than a stack trace at startup.
suggestions.whyItMatters: It turns a silent no-op that used to mask typos into a loud failure — catch it where you have context, not where the SDK does.
suggestions.tiesTo: Claude Agent SDK · v0.3.214 · Jul 18 — rejects unrecognized permission modes

suggestions.title: Drop the experimental flag from your MCP OAuth flow
suggestions.paragraph: Codex 0.144.0 makes interactive MCP authentication generally available. If you gated MCP OAuth behind an experimental opt-in, you can remove that flag and simplify onboarding for your users.
suggestions.whyItMatters: One less experimental toggle in your config is one less thing that breaks when upstream defaults change.
suggestions.tiesTo: Codex · rust-v0.144.0 · Jul 9 — MCP interactive auth GA

suggestions.title: Stream large file uploads to OpenAI instead of buffering them
suggestions.paragraph: v6.47.0 supports streaming file uploads. For any Node service that forwards user files to OpenAI, pipe a read stream straight through instead of reading the whole file into a Buffer first.
suggestions.whyItMatters: Buffering large files in memory is a top cause of OOM crashes in upload endpoints; streaming keeps memory flat regardless of file size.
suggestions.tiesTo: OpenAI Node SDK · v6.47.0 · Jul 14 — streaming file uploads
